name: The Devil Wears a Tie
source:
Bad coworkers make an already stressful job even worse, but what if they had something against you? Your boss seems strangely eager to suggest you do something about it. What that something means is up for discussion: set his desk on fire? Break his computer? Frame him for a crime? The options are endless, and if your boss covers your back… you might as well.

[From [url=https://breezy-the-cat.itch.io/the-devil-weas-a-tie]itch.io[/url]]
